import ctypes as c,json,pathlib,shutil
lib=c.CDLL("libibverbs.so.1",use_errno=True)
lib.ibv_get_device_list.argtypes=[c.POINTER(c.c_int)];lib.ibv_get_device_list.restype=c.POINTER(c.c_void_p)
lib.ibv_get_device_name.argtypes=[c.c_void_p];lib.ibv_get_device_name.restype=c.c_char_p
lib.ibv_open_device.argtypes=[c.c_void_p];lib.ibv_open_device.restype=c.c_void_p
lib.ibv_close_device.argtypes=[c.c_void_p];lib.ibv_close_device.restype=c.c_int
n=c.c_int();devices=lib.ibv_get_device_list(c.byref(n));names=[]
assert n.value==8,("expected eight HCAs",n.value)
for i in range(n.value):
 name=lib.ibv_get_device_name(devices[i]).decode();ctx=lib.ibv_open_device(devices[i]);assert ctx,(name,c.get_errno());names.append(name);lib.ibv_close_device(ctx)
print(json.dumps(dict(hcas=names,verbs_open_passed=True,device_nodes=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path("/dev/infiniband").glob("*")],ib_write_bw=shutil.which("ib_write_bw"))))
